species.name: Walleye
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 12–36 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the northeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
